cfg.raw_spark: An app for wedding photographers who lose their deposit when couples cancel two days before the shoot.

answers.m2: Last Saturday a couple cancelled on Thursday night. Lena spent the morning re-reading her contract clause, then wrote off the deposit and blocked the date in her calendar anyway.
answers.m3: My colleague Jordan, another wedding photographer, told me last month he now takes half the fee upfront through a payment link after a March cancellation burned him.
answers.m4: Priya, a wedding caterer I met at a market, keeps a paper deposit ledger per event. For her the pain is cancellations inside 48 hours, the payment part is fine.
answers.m5: Lena uses a HoneyBook contract template, but it stores no card on file, so when the couple ghosted there was nothing to charge.
answers.m6: "I am done being the bad guy about deposits," she said after the March one.
answers.m7: Rob shoots corporate headshots on retainer for two agencies. Cancellations cost him nothing because the retainer bills monthly whether shoots happen or not.
